subject: COBOL-WORDS directive
notes: GR5 'the content of literal-6 shall not be used as a user-defined word within this compilation group' (cite.py OK §7.3.10.4 5)). ReservedWordSet.Compose adds CobolWordsMap.Reserved to the §8.9 funnel, so every user-defined-word position rejects it with COBOL0901. Probed beyond the data-name golden: RESERVE "ZQX" then paragraph-name ZQX -> COBOL0901; RESERVE "ZQY" then PROGRAM-ID. ZQY -> COBOL0901. Case-insensitive via OrdinalIgnoreCase. || editions (adjudicator): 2023 only (new in COBOL-2023: Foreword list 'Additional compiler directives were added: COBOL-WORDS directive'; Annex E.3.3 item 12, cite.py OK §E.3.3 12)); below 2023 the directive word is COBOL0900
